constructor.details: START_BLOCK_SLOT is set to type(uint256).max here so that it will be a dead value         in the singleton.

params._addresses: Set of L1 contract addresses. These should be the proxies.
params._l2ChainId: The L2 chain ID that this SystemConfig configures.

isCustomGasToken().custom:legacy: @notice Returns whether the custom gas token feature is enabled.

returns._0: bool True if the custom gas token feature is enabled, false otherwise.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

returns._0: bool True if the system is paused, false otherwise.

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions anymore. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby removing any functionality that is only available to the owner.

params._denominator: EIP-1559 base fee max change denominator.

params._enabled: Whether the feature should be enabled or disabled.

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

returns.addr_: Address of the unsafe block signer.

UNSAFE_BLOCK_SIGNER_SLOT.details: NOTE: this value will be migrated to another storage slot in a future version.         User input should not be placed in storage in this contract until this migration         happens. It is unlikely that keccak second preimage resistance will be broken,         but it is better to be safe than sorry.

overhead.custom:deprecated: No longer writable, and `setGasConfigEcotone` emits zero in its place.                    Retained so offchain readers of the getter keep working.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_NotProxyAdmin().notice: Thrown when the caller is not the ProxyAdmin.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_NotProxyAdminOrProxy.notice: Thrown when the caller is not the ProxyAdmin owner or the ProxyAdmin.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_NotProxyAdminOwner().notice: Thrown when the caller is not the ProxyAdmin owner.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_NotResolvedDelegateP.notice: Thrown when the current contract is not a ResolvedDelegateProxy.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_NotSharedProxyAdminO.notice: Thrown when the ProxyAdmin owner of the current contract is not the same as the         ProxyAdmin owner of the other Proxy address provided.

ProxyAdminOwnedBase_ProxyAdminNotFound().notice: Thrown when the ProxyAdmin owner of the current contract is not found.

ReinitializableBase_ZeroInitVersion().notice: Thrown when the initialization version is zero.

SystemConfig_InvalidFeatureState().notice: Thrown when attempting to enable/disable a feature when already enabled/disabled,         respectively.

FeatureSet(bytes32,bool).notice: Emitted when a feature is set.

DELAYED_WETH_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the DelayedWETH address is stored at.

L1_CROSS_DOMAIN_MESSENGER_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the L1CrossDomainMessenger address is stored at.

L1_ERC_721_BRIDGE_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the L1ERC721Bridge address is stored at.

L1_STANDARD_BRIDGE_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the L1StandardBridge address is stored at.

OPCM_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the OPCM address is stored at.

OPTIMISM_MINTABLE_ERC20_FACTORY_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the OptimismMintableERC20Factory address is stored at.

OPTIMISM_PORTAL_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the OptimismPortal address is stored at.

START_BLOCK_SLOT().notice: Storage slot for block at which the op-node can start searching for logs from.

UNSAFE_BLOCK_SIGNER_SLOT().notice: Storage slot that the unsafe block signer is stored at.         Storing it at this deterministic storage slot allows for decoupling the storage         layout from the way that `solc` lays out storage. The `op-node` uses a storage         proof to fetch this value.

basefeeScalar().notice: Basefee scalar value. Part of the L2 fee calculation since the Ecotone network upgrade.

batcherHash().notice: Identifier for the batcher.         For version 1 of this configuration, this is represented as an address left-padded         with zeros to 32 bytes.

blobbasefeeScalar().notice: Blobbasefee scalar value. Part of the L2 fee calculation since the Ecotone network upgrade.

eip1559Denominator().notice: The EIP-1559 base fee max change denominator.

getAddresses().notice: Consolidated getter for the Addresses struct.

guardian().notice: Returns the guardian address of the SuperchainConfig.

initVersion().notice: Getter for the current initialization version.

initialize(address,uint32,uint32,bytes32.notice: Initializer.         The resource config must be set before the require check.

isFeatureEnabled(bytes32).notice: Bytes32 feature flag name to boolean enabled value.

l2ChainId().notice: The L2 chain ID that this SystemConfig configures.

lastUsedOPCMVersion().notice: Getter for the version of the last used OPCM.

maximumGasLimit().notice: Returns the maximum L2 gas limit that can be safely set for the system to         operate. This bound is used to prevent the gas limit from being set too high         and causing the system to be unable to process and/or prove L2 blocks.

minBaseFee().notice: The minimum base fee, in wei.

minimumGasLimit().notice: Returns the minimum L2 gas limit that can be safely set for the system to         operate. The L2 gas limit must be larger than or equal to the amount of         gas that is allocated for deposits per block plus the amount of gas that         is allocated for the system transaction.         This function is used to determine if changes to parameters are safe.

overhead().notice: Fixed L2 gas overhead. Ignored by op-node after Ecotone.

paused().notice: Returns the current pause state for this network. If the network is using         ETHLockbox, the system is paused if either the global pause is active or the pause         is active where the ETHLockbox address is used as the identifier. If the network is         not using ETHLockbox, the system is paused if either the global pause is active or         the pause is active where the OptimismPortal address is used as the identifier.

proxyAdmin().notice: Getter for the ProxyAdmin contract that owns this Proxy contract.

proxyAdminOwner().notice: Getter for the owner of the ProxyAdmin.

resourceConfig().notice: A getter for the resource config.         Ensures that the struct is returned instead of a tuple.

scalar().notice: Dynamic L2 gas overhead. Used as part of the L2 fee calculation.         The most significant byte is used to determine the version since the         Ecotone network upgrade.

setBatcherHash(address).notice: Updates the batcher hash by formatting a provided batcher address.

setBatcherHash(bytes32).notice: Updates the batcher hash. Can only be called by the owner.

setDAFootprintGasScalar(uint16).notice: Updates the DA footprint gas scalar. Can only be called by the owner.

setEIP1559Params(uint32,uint32).notice: Updates the EIP-1559 parameters of the chain. Can only be called by the owner.

setFeature(bytes32,bool).notice: Sets a feature flag enabled or disabled. Can only be called by the ProxyAdmin or         its owner.

setGasConfigEcotone(uint32,uint32).notice: Updates gas config as of the Ecotone upgrade. Can only be called by the owner.

setGasLimit(uint64).notice: Updates the L2 gas limit. Can only be called by the owner.

setMinBaseFee(uint64).notice: Updates the minimum base fee. Can only be called by the owner.         Setting this value to 0 is equivalent to disabling the min base fee feature

setOperatorFeeScalars(uint32,uint64).notice: Updates the operator fee parameters. Can only be called by the owner.

setUnsafeBlockSigner(address).notice: Updates the unsafe block signer address. Can only be called by the owner.

superchainConfig().notice: The SuperchainConfig contract that manages the pause state.

unsafeBlockSigner().notice: High level getter for the unsafe block signer address.         Unsafe blocks can be propagated across the p2p network if they are signed by the         key corresponding to this address.

userdoc.notice: The SystemConfig contract is used to manage configuration of an Optimism network.         All configuration is stored on L1 and picked up by L2 as part of the derivation of         the L2 chain.
